{{Quote|After the final shouted ''dralshy'a'' died away, I told Swifto about the latest academic thinking about the Zhell, the Taungs and ''Dha Werda Verda''. I was curious to see what this veteran defender of Imperial Center would think about the irony of a Taung war poem giving rise to a Mandalorian tradition, and that tradition in turn being passed on by Imperial Center's guardians.|Eschul Shaywa|<ref name="AncientCoruscant" />}}
'''Eschul Shaywa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Shaywa was a contributor for ''[[Imperial Center Today]]'', and wrote a piece on the history of the ancient [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] peoples as remembered through the ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]''.<ref name="AncientCoruscant" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eschul Shaywa was introduced in the second installment of [[Jason Fry]]'s official [[Star Wars Blog|''Star Wars'' Blog]] series, "[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|The Essential Guide to Warfare: Author's Cut]]," entitled "Ancient Coruscant."
